title: Лазурные сказания Уэлша и Шедара
alt: Welsh & Shedar / The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar Welsh & Shedar 蒼き伝承 ウェルシュ&シェーダー
description: The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world. (Source: Crunchyroll)
